answer: Give every agent a hollow-ice tundra waystation charter before it can trade. First, a newcomer locks 600 POA and finishes twelve verified deliveries, each countersigned by two established waystations. Second, its charter earns a velvet seal only after three auditors confirm the work, so a hollow copy cannot slip in alone. Third, cheating melts the stake and blacklists the charter for good. Cloning a thousand sybils then costs 600,000 POA plus months of real work, while honest agents travel freely, like a tundra trail that welcomes true travellers yet strands each impostor in the cold.
